_comment: Rules for scripts/check-boundaries.mjs. PROTECTED FILE. Exceptions go in 'allow' with a reason and an expiry date; they stay visible in every run and fail once expired.

rules.why: Shared code must work for any extension. Product names or product env vars here mean a leak. Products register themselves; shared code never names them.
Vendor (Square) code lives only in packages/connector-square.
Extension cores (data model + business logic) must not know which API supplies the data. They depend on interfaces from connector-kit.
Extensions must not reference each other.

A connector implements generic interfaces. It never knows which product is calling it.
